description:
Indyx unlocks the potential of what you own. As the best FREE digital wardrobe and styling app, you can index your closet, plan outfits, track your cost-per-wear, share your closet with friends, and get styled by experts...all in one place!

DIGITIZE YOUR WARDROBE
Indyx gives you the tools to create an oh-so-scrollable digital wardrobe that makes shopping your own closet just as satisfying as doom scrolling a shopping site. Add your own photos — messy hanger shots, rushed flatlays, whatever you've got — and we'll automatically remove the background, auto-tag with AI that works, and transform them into clean, editorial flatlays. You can also forward shopping receipts or paste in product links to instantly add items to your closet.

STYLE YOUR WARDROBE
Plan outfits on your own with fully customizable drag-and-drop outfit boards. Or, take advantage of our personal styling services to get professional help re-styling your own wardrobe along with personalized shopping recommendations. No random outfits styled by robots or complete chance, just real style solutions along with just-for-you tips and tricks that make all the difference. 

SHARE YOUR WARDROBE
Ever wanted to peek into someone else's closet? With Indyx, now you can. Share your closet with friends to get help from those you already trust the most. And, browse the featured Open Closets of other Indyx users to get real-life style inspiration, from what they *really* own down to exactly how they mix-and-match those pieces into outfits. 

FULL FEATURE LIST FOR THE INDYX CLOSET APP

Digital Closet Organizer:
+ Add items your way: upload your own photos, forward shopping receipts, or paste product links from retailer websites
+ No good photos? No problem. Snap them messy and we'll handle the rest. Enhance transforms any hanger shot, on-model image, or rushed flatlay into a clean, editorial image, and AI auto-tags category, subcategory, and color for every item
+ You can then add brand, season, location, and more — and, filter or search across your entire wardrobe by any of the above
+ Organize your closet however you like and customize your view: from close-up details to the full wardrobe at a glance

Closet Analytics:
+ Sort your closet by number of wears and cost-per-wear (CPW)
+ Deep dive into your wardrobe dashboard with interactive charts that nudge you to wear your underused pieces, and teach you what’s actually worth buying more of next time
 
Outfit Planning & Tracking:
+ Create your own outfits with our fully customizable drag-and-drop outfit boards
+ Use outfit tags to organize your outfits into categories
+ Plan your week by scheduling outfits to a calendar, automatically tracking the cost-per-wear of your pieces
+ Save your OOTD selfies to the calendar to remember how you looked and felt in each outfit, visualizing how your style develops over time

Discover Your Personal Style:
+ Use the Style Quiz to help articulate your style words
+ Take our free 8-week Style Workshop course to get inspired, define your style, and build a wardrobe plan to match

Share with Friends:
+ Your closet is private by default, but open your closet to share with friends and other Indyxers
+ Get inspired by browsing the real-life closets of other Indyx users

Get Styled:
+ Get your closet styled by friends or other Indyx users to find fresh outfit inspiration
+ Book a Lookbook for a set of ten (10) expertly styled outfits from your own closet, and with a few new pieces mixed in (if you choose)

Travel Outfit Planning and Packing Lists:
+ Use Collections to build seasonal capsules or packing lists
+ Add outfits to a Collection to automatically generate an itemized list, so you never forget an important piece again
